questions.prompt: G2 BRIEF — organized-experiment-ww48 (Next.js CRM). Finding A1: six authenticated route handlers do `return withAuth(...)` without `await`, so their try/catch never maps ApiError/ZodError and clients get 500 instead of 401/403/404/409/400. You will delegate the fix to a coding agent that has never seen this repo. Write the brief: goal, allowed files, boundaries, test command, stop condition. Commit to your brief before opening the model answer; then tick each checkpoint you covered and add up the weights.

keyPoints.text: [w3] Goal: the six handler call sites become `return await withAuth(...)` so every thrown error reaches toErrorResponse; the brief names the observable result (401/403/404/400 reach the client, not 500).
[w3] Goal includes the second handler in the same file: leads/[leadId]/route.ts has TWO unawaited sites (GET and PATCH), so 'six sites in five files' is stated explicitly.
[w2] Allowed files: the five route files plus NEW test files under src/tests/ (the only directory vitest includes).
[w3] Boundary: do not change withAuth or toErrorResponse; the wrapper's contract (return the handler's promise, throw ApiError 401) is correct and other code relies on it.
[w2] Test command: `npm run test:run` (vitest run). Plain `npm test` is watch-mode vitest and never exits, which hangs an unattended agent.
[w3] Acceptance: one route-level test per handler that asserts the HTTP status code (e.g. 401 with no session), not merely that something threw.
keyPoints.quote: Add a route-level test per handler that asserts the status code, not just the thrown error.

keyPoints.text: [w2] Stop condition: stop when all six sites are awaited and the new tests are green; if any handler needs more than the one-word change, stop and report instead of redesigning.
